text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Are you two ready?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Huh, it's perfect! With all my respect and 
esteem!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
With all my feelings of admiration and my 
ideals!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"To that kind, wonderful person who's 
always taking care of me...!"

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: With all my gratitude!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if King-san will like it. A 
handmade teacup...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I misjudged my strength and smashed it 
time and time again, but I have finally 
completed it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
She's definitely going to love it! You 
worked so hard on it... Just listening to 
you, I can feel all the love you put in!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, on my end... A keychain 
might've been a bit too childish for a 
mature woman like Maruzen-san...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that the keychain you searched so 
hard to find!? It even has a miniature 
version of Maruzen-san's beloved car on 
it!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I'm a little anxious too. 
Tachyon-san is so amazing, so I wonder if 
the aroma set I prepared is enough...

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, my heart is pounding! Aaah, my heart 
is racing so! Aaah, I'm so nervous~!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"I wondered why I was summoned, but 
this... It's quite heartbreaking, isn't 
it."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...It seems arriving a little too early 
was a mistake."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Ehehe♪ Those girls are just so adorable!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"It's strange, though. For some reason, I 
feel this odd sense of kinship with 
Chiyo-chan. Not just in her running, but I 
can't seem to take my eyes off her..."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I understand. Whenever I'm with 
Kawakami-san, I just can't stay composed, 
or rather, I feel like I just can't leave 
her alone...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... That is intriguing. Could it be 
what they call 'compatibility'? Well, I 
suppose I'm somewhat similar.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. For now, let's keep what we just 
heard a secret. Those girls might be so 
shocked they'll faint!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed. Pretending not to notice at 
times like this is what a first-rate lady 
would do, after all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
For my part, I'd love to examine their 
reaction and pulse upon realizing they 
were overheard... but well, perhaps I 
should hold back this time.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's here...! Ready, both of you? One, 
two, three――!

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much, as always!
